name: Implied lamination cycles (build class)
description: Derives the HDI build class (1+N+1, 2+N+2, ...) and the implied number of press cycles from the via spans and the layer stack. Informational only: the derivation is objective, but 'too many cycles' is a cost judgment rather than a manufacturability rule, so this check never fails or warns.
what_it_measures: Number of lamination (press) cycles the via spans imply for this stackup.
